summary: The team is executing a China-first SEO/AI-visibility push for Asia Start and Intelligent China while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and managing a time-sensitive Outlook lockout.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the seven-month visibility strategy: Joseph must draft audience/prompt focus and build profiles from Asia Start participants and CRM hot leads, and the team needs to complete the Intelligent China webpage and drive traffic to it. The knowledge website redesign is also in motion—Joseph shares his HTML file, Joker makes design changes, and a 30-minute working session will mark specific feedback; decisions include dispersing videos by topic and integrating BCI/BSI indices. Urgent this week: resolve the Outlook lockout across all devices and confirm backend unlock with CKGSB. Upcoming: Asia Start campaign reports for European colleagues, video strategy discussion, and European Chamber panelist confirmations (Holly Lei priority, Raphael fallback) for the Nov 13 event.
